newsitem.title: USA: United Auto Group Inc Q4 pro forma net rises.
newsitem.headline: United Auto Group Inc Q4 pro forma net rises.

text.p: NOTE: The results for all periods have been adjusted to reflect the company's completion of its initial public offering of 6.25 million shares on October 28, 1996, the 1996 dealership acquisitions and the acquisition of previously outstanding minority interest in certain subsidiaries.
Actual revenues for the fourth quarter were $347.2 million compared to $213.3 million in the comparable 1995 period.

Excluding a one-time extraordinary charge of about $5.0 million in the fourth quarter, net income increased to $1.3 million, or $0.08 per share, from $0.4 million, or $0.05 per share. Including the charge the net loss was $0.23 per share for the fourth quarter.

Actual revenues for fiscal year 1996 rose to $1.3 billion from $805.6 million in 1995. Net income was $7.5 million, or $0.69 per share, compared to a loss of $3.5 million, or $0.63 per share, in 1995. Earnings per share for 1996, after the extraordinary item, was $0.23 per share.
